intro.en: This reading passage explains that animals are communities like us, and that Islam teaches mercy toward them. Read each sentence slowly and notice the Hadith examples.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek parhne ka matn hai jo batata hai ke janwar bhi hamari tarah ummatein hain aur Islam unke saath narmi sikhata hai. Har jumla aahista parhein aur Hadith ki misalon par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: يُبَيِّنُ هذا النَّصُّ أَنَّ الحَيَواناتِ أُمَمٌ مِثْلُنا، وَأَنَّ الإِسْلامَ يَدْعو إِلى الرَّحْمَةِ بِها. اِقْرَأْ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ بِبُطْءٍ وَانْتَبِهْ إِلى أَمْثِلَةِ الأَحاديثِ.

dialogue.en: The world of animals is like the world of humans.
dialogue.ur: Janwaron ki duniya insaan ki duniya jaisi hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿وَما مِنْ دابَّةٍ في الأَرْضِ وَلا طائِرٍ يَطيرُ بِجَناحَيْهِ إِلّا أُمَمٌ أَمْثالُكُم﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: wa mā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi wa lā ṭā'irin yaṭīru bi-janāḥayhi illā umamun amthālukum
dialogue.en: Allah the Exalted said: there is no creature on earth nor bird flying with its wings except they are communities like you.
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: zameen par koi chalne wala aur koi parinda jo apne paron se udta hai, magar woh tumhari tarah ummatein hain.

dialogue.ar: رَحْمَةُ الإِنْسانِ لِلحَيَوانِ قَدْ تُدْخِلُ صاحِبَها الجَنَّة.
dialogue.tr: raḥmatu l-insāni lil-ḥayawāni qad tudkhilu ṣāḥibahā l-janna
dialogue.en: A person's mercy to an animal may take them into Paradise.
dialogue.ur: Insaan ka janwar par rahm usay Jannat mein daakhil kar sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: اِشْتَدَّ العَطَشُ بِرَجُلٍ فَنَزَلَ بِئْراً وَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ خَرَج.
dialogue.tr: ishtadda l-ʿaṭashu bi-rajulin fa-nazala bi'ran wa shariba thumma kharaj
dialogue.en: A man was very thirsty, so he went down a well, drank, then came out.
dialogue.ur: Ek aadmi ko bahut pyaas lagi, woh kunwen mein utra, piya aur phir nikla.

dialogue.ar: فَإِذا كَلْبٌ يَلْهَثُ مِنَ العَطَشِ، فَمَلَأَ خُفَّهُ ماءً وَسَقى الكَلْب.
dialogue.tr: fa-idhā kalbun yalhathu mina l-ʿaṭash, fa-mala'a khuffahu mā'an wa saqā l-kalb
dialogue.en: He found a dog panting from thirst, so he filled his shoe with water and gave the dog a drink.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ek kutta pyaas se haanp raha tha, us ne apna moza paani se bhara aur kutte ko pilaya.

dialogue.en: Allah appreciated it and forgave him.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne uski qadr ki aur usay bakhsh diya.

dialogue.ar: فَقالوا: يا رَسولَ اللهِ، وَإِنَّ لَنا في البَهائِمِ أَجْراً؟ فَقال: نَعَم، في كُلِّ ذاتِ كَبِدٍ رَطْبَةٍ أَجْر.
dialogue.tr: fa-qālū: yā rasūla llāh, wa-inna lanā fī l-bahā'imi ajran? fa-qāla: naʿam, fī kulli dhāti kabidin raṭbatin ajr
dialogue.en: They said: O Messenger of Allah, is there reward for us in animals? He said: Yes, in every living creature there is reward.
dialogue.ur: Sahaba ne poocha: kya janwaron mein bhi hamare liye ajr hai? Farmaya: haan, har zinda jaandar mein ajr hai.

dialogue.ar: دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النّارَ في هِرَّةٍ رَبَطَتْها، فَلَمْ تُطْعِمْها وَلَمْ تَدَعْها تَأْكُلُ مِنْ خَشاشِ الأَرْض.
dialogue.tr: dakhalati mra'atun n-nāra fī hirratin rabaṭathā, fa-lam tuṭʿimhā wa-lam tadaʿhā ta'kulu min khashāshi l-arḍ
dialogue.en: A woman entered the Fire because of a cat she tied up; she did not feed it nor let it eat from the creatures of the earth.
dialogue.ur: Ek aurat ek billi ki wajah se Jahannam mein gayi jisay usne baandh diya, na khilaya aur na chhoda ke zameen ke keede khaa le.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ سَخَّرَ اللهُ كَثيراً مِنَ الحَيَواناتِ لِخِدْمَةِ الإِنْسان.
dialogue.tr: wa-qad sakhkhara llāhu kathīran mina l-ḥayawānāti li-khidmati l-insān
dialogue.en: Allah has made many animals serve humans.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne bohat se janwar insaan ki khidmat ke liye musakhkhar kar diye.

dialogue.ar: وَجاءَ الأَمْرُ بِالرِّفْقِ بِالحَيَوانِ، وَالنَّهْيُ عَنْ إِرْهاقِه.
dialogue.tr: wa-jā'a l-amru bi-r-rifqi bil-ḥayawān, wan-nahyu ʿan irhāqih
dialogue.en: Islam commands kindness to animals and forbids overworking them.
dialogue.ur: Janwar ke saath narmi ka hukm aaya aur use thaka dene se mana kiya gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَتَنْهى الشَّريعَةُ عَنْ إِرْهاقِ الحَيَوانِ بِالعَمَلِ فَوْقَ ما يَسْتَطيع.
dialogue.tr: wa-tanhā sh-sharīʿatu ʿan irhāqi l-ḥayawāni bil-ʿamali fawqa mā yastaṭīʿ
dialogue.en: The Shariah forbids tiring an animal with work beyond what it can bear.
dialogue.ur: Shariat janwar se uski taaqat se zyada kaam lene se mana karti hai.

dialogue.en: Allah has cursed the one who branded it (the donkey on the face).
dialogue.ur: Allah ne us par laanat ki jisne (gadhe ke) chehre par daagh lagaya.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ اللهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسانَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْء.
dialogue.tr: inna llāha kataba l-iḥsāna ʿalā kulli shay'
dialogue.en: Allah has prescribed excellence (kindness) in everything.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne har cheez par ihsaan (achha salook) farz kiya hai.

dialogue.ar: لا يَنْبَغي أَنْ يُعَذَّبَ بِالنّارِ إِلّا رَبُّ النّار.
dialogue.tr: lā yanbaghī an yuʿadhdhaba bin-nāri illā rabbu n-nār
dialogue.en: No one should punish with fire except the Lord of the fire.
dialogue.ur: Aag se saza dena sirf aag ke Rab ko zeba hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ أَبو الدَّرْداءِ لِبَعيرِه: إِنِّي لَمْ أُحَمِّلْكَ فَوْقَ طاقَتِك.
dialogue.tr: wa qāla Abū d-Dardā'i li-baʿīrih: innī lam uḥammilka fawqa ṭāqatik
dialogue.en: Abu ad-Darda said to his camel: I did not load you beyond your strength.
dialogue.ur: Abu Darda ne apne oont se kaha: maine tujh par teri taaqat se zyada bojh nahi dala.

q.en: What does the Quranic verse in the passage say about animals?
q.ur: Matn ki Quran ki aayat janwaron ke baare mein kya kehti hai?
q.ar: ماذا تَقولُ الآيَةُ الكَريمَةُ في النَّصِّ عَنِ الحَيَواناتِ؟

q.en: Why did Allah forgive the man in the Hadith?
q.ur: Hadith mein Allah ne us aadmi ko kyun bakhsha?
q.ar: لِماذا غَفَرَ اللهُ لِلرَّجُلِ في الحَديثِ؟

options: He gave water to a thirsty dog

q.en: What happened to the woman who tied up the cat?
q.ur: Jis aurat ne billi ko baandha uska kya hua?
q.ar: ماذا حَدَثَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الَّتي حَبَسَتِ القِطَّةَ؟

q.en: Which animal did Abu ad-Darda speak to at his death?
q.ur: Abu Darda ne wafat ke waqt kis janwar se baat ki?
q.ar: مَعَ أَيِّ حَيَوانٍ تَكَلَّمَ أَبو الدَّرْداءِ عِنْدَ وَفاتِهِ؟

title.en: Vocabulary, Expressions and Understanding the Text
title.ur: Alfaz, Tabeeraat aur Matn ki Samajh

intro.en: Here you practise the words of the text: find the plural, the opposite, and the occasion of each Hadith. Learn the useful phrases like «غَفَرَ لَهُ» (He forgave him) and «شَكَرَ لَهُ» (He appreciated him).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein matn ke alfaz ki mashq hai: jama, ult (zid) aur har Hadith ka mauqa dhoondna. Mufeed jumle seekhein jaise «غَفَرَ لَهُ» (usne use bakhsha) aur «شَكَرَ لَهُ» (usne uski qadr ki).
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى كَلِماتِ النَّصِّ: تَجِدُ الجَمْعَ وَالضِّدَّ وَمُناسَبَةَ كُلِّ حَديثٍ. وَتَتَعَلَّمُ عِباراتٍ مُفيدَةً مِثْلَ «غَفَرَ لَهُ» وَ«شَكَرَ لَهُ».

q.en: What is the opposite of «الإِحْسان» (good treatment)?

options_ar: أَمْلاكٌ يُحْبَسُ نَفْعُها في سَبيلِ اللهِ

q.ur: Kaun sa jumla 'usne use bakhsha' hai?

intro.en: Tamyeez is a noun in the accusative case that clears up something unclear. Example: «أَنا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً» (I have more wealth than you): the word «مالاً» explains in what way 'more'. There are two types: Tamyeez of the thing (الذّات), after numbers and measures, like «أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً» (eleven stars), and Tamyeez of the relation (النِّسْبة).
intro.ur: Tamyeez ek ism hai jo mansoob hota hai aur kisi mubham baat ko wazeh karta hai. Misal: «أَنا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً» mein lafz «مالاً» batata hai ke 'zyada' kis cheez mein hai. Iski do qismein hain: Tamyeez-uz-zaat (adad aur paimaish ke baad, jaise «أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً») aur Tamyeez-un-nisbat.
intro.ar: التَّمْييزُ اسْمٌ مَنْصوبٌ يُزيلُ الغُموضَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ. مِثالٌ: «أَنا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً»؛ كَلِمَةُ «مالاً» تُبَيِّنُ جِهَةَ الكَثْرَةِ. وَهُوَ نَوْعانِ: تَمْييزُ الذّاتِ بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ وَالمَقاديرِ مِثْلَ «أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً»، وَتَمْييزُ النِّسْبَةِ.

dialogue.en: I gave him Zakat al-Fitr: a sa' of wheat.
dialogue.ur: Maine use sadaqa-e-fitr diya: ek saa gandum.

dialogue.ar: فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْراً يَرَهُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-man yaʿmal mithqāla dharratin khayran yarah
dialogue.en: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.
dialogue.ur: Jo zarre barabar neki karega woh use dekh lega.

dialogue.en: I saw eleven stars.
dialogue.ur: Maine gyarah sitare dekhe.

dialogue.tr: kafā billāhi shahīdan baynī wa baynakum
dialogue.en: Allah is enough as a witness between me and you.
dialogue.ur: Mere aur tumhare darmiyan Allah gawah kafi hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً وَأَعَزُّ نَفَراً.
dialogue.tr: anā aktharu minka mālan wa-aʿazzu nafaran
dialogue.en: I have more wealth than you and am stronger in manpower.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas tujh se zyada maal hai aur main afraad mein zyada izzat wala hoon.

dialogue.en: And who is more truthful than Allah in speech?
dialogue.ur: Aur baat mein Allah se zyada sacha kaun hai?

dialogue.en: And the head has flared with white hair.
dialogue.ur: Aur sar budhape (safedi) se bhadak utha.

dialogue.en: And We made the earth burst with springs.
dialogue.ur: Aur humne zameen ko chashmon se phaad diya.

q.en: Tamyeez is put in which case?
q.ur: Tamyeez kis haalat mein aata hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ حالَةٍ إِعْرابِيَّةٍ يَأْتي التَّمْييزُ؟

q.en: Which word is the Tamyeez in «أَنا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً»?
q.ur: «أَنا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً» mein tamyeez kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: ما التَّمْييزُ في «أَنا أَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مالاً»؟

q.en: What does «مالاً» explain in that sentence?
q.ur: Us jumle mein «مالاً» kya wazeh karta hai?

q.en: Which is Tamyeez of the thing (after a number)?
q.ur: Kaun sa tamyeez-uz-zaat hai (adad ke baad)?
q.ar: أَيُّ هذِهِ الأَمْثِلَةِ تَمْييزُ ذاتٍ (بَعْدَ عَدَدٍ)؟

intro.en: In these two listening parts you learn to sort animals by how they move and live: those that fly, swim, crawl or walk; and by the number of legs. Learn the animal names below.
intro.ur: In do sunne ke hissay mein aap janwaron ko unke chalne aur rehne ke tareeqe se alag karna seekhenge: udne, tairne, rengne aur chalne wale; aur taangon ki tadaad se. Neeche janwaron ke naam seekhein.
intro.ar: في هذَيْنِ الجُزْأَيْنِ تَتَعَلَّمُ تَصْنيفَ الحَيَواناتِ بِحَسَبِ حَرَكَتِها وَعَيْشِها: ما يَطيرُ وَما يَسْبَحُ وَما يَزْحَفُ وَما يَمْشي، وَبِحَسَبِ عَدَدِ الأَرْجُلِ. تَعَلَّمْ أَسْماءَ الحَيَواناتِ الآتِيَةَ.

options_ar: عُضْوٌ يَمْشي بِهِ الإِنْسانُ أَوِ الحَيَوانُ

intro.en: Practise speaking with a partner about animals: which are useful, which are harmful, which you love, and how to treat them. Then write a short topic called «الرِّفْقُ بِالحَيَوانِ» (kindness to animals).
intro.ur: Sathi ke saath janwaron ke baare mein baat karne ki mashq karein: kaun se mufeed hain, kaun se nuqsandeh, kaun sa pasand hai aur un se kaisa salook karein. Phir «الرِّفْقُ بِالحَيَوانِ» par chhota mazmoon likhein.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الحَديثِ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنِ الحَيَواناتِ: أَيُّها نافِعٌ وَأَيُّها ضارٌّ وَأَيُّها تُحِبُّ، وَكَيْفَ نُعامِلُها. ثُمَّ تَكْتُبُ مَوْضوعًا قَصيرًا عُنْوانُهُ «الرِّفْقُ بِالحَيَوانِ».

dialogue.en: Which animals are useful to humans?
dialogue.ur: Insaan ke liye mufeed janwar kaun se hain?

dialogue.en: Which animals are harmful to humans?
dialogue.ur: Insaan ke liye nuqsandeh janwar kaun se hain?

dialogue.en: Which animal do you love? Why?
dialogue.ur: Aap ko kaun sa janwar pasand hai? Kyun?

dialogue.en: Do you keep an animal in your house?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ghar mein koi janwar paalte hain?

dialogue.en: How do you treat animals?
dialogue.ur: Aap janwar ke saath kaisa salook karte hain?

dialogue.en: What do you advise these people?
dialogue.ur: Aap in logon ko kya naseehat karenge?

intro.en: This lesson reviews how to write hamza. At the start of a word it is written on an alif (أ with fatha or damma, إ with kasra). In the middle it sits on a seat chosen by the strongest vowel: yaa (ئ) for kasra, waw (ؤ) for damma, alif (أ) for fatha. At the end, it follows the letter before it, for example جُزْء, قَرَأَ, لُؤْلُؤ, قُرِئَ.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hamza likhne ka muraja'a hai. Lafz ke shuru mein hamza alif par likha jata hai (fatha ya damma ke saath أ, kasra ke saath إ). Beech mein sab se taqatwar harkat ke mutabiq kursi milti hai: kasra ke liye ya (ئ), damma ke liye waw (ؤ), fatha ke liye alif (أ). Aakhir mein hamza pehle harf ke mutabiq likha jata hai, jaise جُزْء، قَرَأَ، لُؤْلُؤ، قُرِئَ.
intro.ar: تُراجِعُ في هذا الدَّرْسِ كِتابَةَ الهَمْزَةِ. في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ تُكْتَبُ عَلى أَلِفٍ (أ بِالفَتْحِ أَوِ الضَّمِّ، وَإ بِالكَسْرِ). وَفي الوَسَطِ تُكْتَبُ عَلى كُرْسِيٍّ بِحَسَبِ أَقْوى حَرَكَةٍ: ياءٌ (ئ) لِلْكَسْرَةِ، وَواوٌ (ؤ) لِلضَّمَّةِ، وَأَلِفٌ (أ) لِلْفَتْحَةِ. وَفي الآخِرِ تَتْبَعُ الحَرَكَةَ قَبْلَها، مِثْلَ جُزْء، قَرَأَ، لُؤْلُؤ، قُرِئَ.

q.en: Which seat does hamza take in «مُؤْمِن»?
q.ur: «مُؤْمِن» mein hamza kis kursi par hai?
q.ar: عَلى أَيِّ كُرْسِيٍّ تُكْتَبُ الهَمْزَةُ في «مُؤْمِن»؟

q.ar: الهَمْزَةُ بَعْدَ السُّكونِ في آخِرِ الكَلِمَةِ، مِثْلَ «جُزْء»، تُكْتَبُ:

title.en: Grammar: La that Negates the Whole Class

intro.en: «لا» that negates the whole class denies something completely. The noun after it has no tanween and is in the accusative form (without tanween): «لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» (no doubt in it), «لا بَأْسَ عَلَيْكَ» (no harm on you). Each of these denies the entire kind.
intro.ur: «لا» nafiya lil-jins kisi cheez ki poori jins ki nafi karta hai. Iske baad wala ism bagair tanween ke mansoob hota hai: «لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» (isme koi shak nahi), «لا بَأْسَ عَلَيْكَ» (tum par koi harj nahi). Har misal mein poori jins ki nafi hoti hai.
intro.ar: «لا» النّافِيَةُ لِلْجِنْسِ تَنْفي الشَّيْءَ نَفْيًا تامًّا. الاِسْمُ بَعْدَها مَبْنِيٌّ عَلى الفَتْحِ بِلا تَنْوينٍ: «لا رَيْبَ فيهِ»، «لا بَأْسَ عَلَيْكَ». وَكُلٌّ مِنْها يَنْفي الجِنْسَ كُلَّهُ.

dialogue.en: There is no lasting joy.
dialogue.ur: Koi khushi hamesha nahi rehti.

dialogue.en: There is no fruitful olive tree.
dialogue.ur: Koi zaitoon ka darakht phaldaar nahi.

dialogue.en: That is the Book; there is no doubt in it.
dialogue.ur: Yeh woh kitab hai jis mein koi shak nahi.

dialogue.ar: فَلا رَفَثَ وَلا فُسوقَ وَلا جِدالَ في الحَجِّ.
dialogue.tr: fa-lā rafatha wa lā fusūqa wa lā jidāla fī l-ḥajj
dialogue.en: So there is no obscenity, wrongdoing or arguing during Hajj.
dialogue.ur: Hajj mein na fahash baat, na gunah aur na jhagda.

dialogue.en: The traveller grew tired for no benefit.
dialogue.ur: Musafir bila fayda thak gaya.

dialogue.ar: لا فيها غَوْلٌ وَلا هُمْ عَنْها يُنْزَفونَ.
dialogue.tr: lā fīhā ghawlun wa lā hum ʿanhā yunzafūn
dialogue.en: No harm is in it, nor will they be intoxicated by it.
dialogue.ur: Us mein na koi nuqsan hai aur na woh us se behosh honge.

dialogue.en: There is no good in one who abandons prayer.
dialogue.ur: Namaz chhodne wale mein koi khair nahi.

dialogue.en: No harm upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aap par koi harj nahi.

vocab.en: la that negates the whole class

q.ur: «لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» ka matlab kya hai?

options: There is no doubt in it
There is no water in it
There is a doubt in it

q.en: The noun after «لا» that negates the class is:
q.ur: «لا» nafiya lil-jins ke baad ism hota hai:
«لا بَأْسَ عَلَيْكَ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which sentence means 'There is no good in one who abandons prayer'?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla 'namaz chhodne wale mein koi khair nahi' hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَعْني أَنَّ تارِكَ الصَّلاةِ لا خَيْرَ فيهِ؟
